note: Survival's per-boss lines adapt the dungeon-specific utility paragraphs from Wowhead's Survival M+ tips (where to use Feign Death, Emergency Salve, Aspect of the Turtle and Binding Shot); the rest apply general principles from Wowhead's rotation guide (stack Takedown and Boomstick, interrupt with Muzzle) to each mechanic. Mechanic damage types and dispel types were checked against in-game tooltips and Wowhead spell pages.

answers.dispel.poison: Your own poison: {Feign Death} or {Aspect of the Turtle} ({Emergency Salve}). Allies: a party member who can dispel it
answers.dispel.disease: Your own disease: {Feign Death} or {Aspect of the Turtle} ({Emergency Salve}). Allies: a party member who can dispel it
answers.freedom: Yourself: {Disengage} ({Posthaste}). Allies: {Master's Call} from a Cunning pet

general.name: Common
general.sub: Kit summary · Pick a hero talent above

i: tip

Each time you consume Tip of the Spear, there is a 10% chance an owl swoops in and applies Sentinel's Mark to the target (Sentinel). Your next Wildfire Bomb deals 40% more direct damage to a marked target
tip
Takedown calls the owl instantly via Lunar Calling, so press it with a Wildfire Bomb charge in reserve. For 15 seconds after, Takedown becomes Moonlight Chakram
tb
Consuming the mark grants a shield for 10% of max health via Don't Look Back, and Lunar Storm drops 4 arcane bolts within 10 meters
tip
Wowhead's recommended (★) M+ hero talent. The mark procs randomly, so it may not be up when you need it (Wowhead)
tip
Every 30 seconds in combat, your next Kill Command summons a beast (Howl of the Pack Leader): Wyvern (you and your pet deal 10% more damage for 12s), Boar (AoE charge), Bear (10s AoE bleed)
tip
Dire Summons: Kill Command reduces the beast cooldown by 1.5s and Raptor Strike by 1s. Using Takedown summons a beast instantly via Stampede!
tip
Wildfire Bomb extends the Wyvern by 5s each (up to 10s) (Fury of the Wyvern), and Boar hits build up damage for your next Boomstick (Hogstrider)
tip
In Wowhead's build table, the M+ ★ is on Sentinel only. Binding Shot and Don't Look Back are not in this build
tip
Takedown · 1m 30s (1m 15s with Savagery in the Pack Leader build) · You and your pet leap and strike, +20% damage dealt for 8s, generates 50 Focus
tip
Boomstick · 1m · 50 Focus, 3s channel · 4 blasts in a 20-meter frontal cone. Each enemy hit by Wildfire Bomb reduces its cooldown by 2s (up to 10s, Lethal Calibration)
tip
Wildfire Bomb · 18s, 2 charges (Guerrilla Tactics) · Cone fire explosion plus a 6s DoT, 50% more damage to the primary target. Each Kill Command reduces its cooldown by 1s (Wildfire Infusion)
tb
Survival of the Fittest · 1m 30s · You and your pet take 30% less damage for 6s
tb
Aspect of the Turtle · 2m 15s (Born To Be Wild, Improved Aspect of the Turtle) · For 8s all attacks and spells miss you and you take 30% less damage, but you cannot attack
tb
Exhilaration · 1m 30s (Natural Mending) · Instantly heals 30% of max health, plus 12% more over 8s via Rejuvenating Wind
tb
Feign Death · 30s · Drops you from enemy targeting. Cancels some targeted casts (Wowhead)
tip
Roar of Sacrifice · 2m · Ally takes 15% less damage and your pet takes 50% of the damage they receive, 10s (external defensive)
int
Muzzle · 15s melee interrupt, locks the school for 5s (both M+ builds)
int

Intimidation · 1m · Pet stuns for 5s. Freezing Trap · 30s · First enemy to approach is incapacitated for 1m (breaks on damage). Binding Shot · 45s · Tethered enemies that move more than 5 meters are stunned for 3s (Sentinel build). Bosses are immune to all of them
disp
Tranquilizing Shot · 10s · Removes 1 Enrage and 1 magic effect from an enemy. Use it on M+ trash enrages and shields (Wowhead)
disp
No ally dispel. Clear your own poison and disease with Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle (Emergency Salve)
pos
Disengage · 20s backward leap; Posthaste removes roots/snares and gives 50% movement speed for 4s. Harpoon · 20s · Pulls you to an enemy 8-30 meters away
tip
Misdirection · 30s · Transfers threat to the tank for 8s. Ferocity pets bring Primal Rage (Bloodlust); Cunning pets bring Master's Call (removes roots/snares from an ally)
tip
Devour week: shields are removed by healing received. Clear your own with Exhilaration
int
Ascendant week: slow the orbs with Intimidation and Freezing Trap, and interrupt with Muzzle. Handling a whole group is hard (Wowhead)
tip
Voidbound week: don't hold Takedown on the spawned enemy. The affix refunds the cooldown (Wowhead)
pos
Pulsar week: as melee you can easily take the tank's orb. If far away, get there with Disengage and Aspect of the Cheetah
tip
+12 and above, Xal'atath's Guile: each death removes 15 seconds

sentinel.title: Sentinel Key Points
items: Press {Takedown} with a {Wildfire Bomb} charge in reserve. Put a bomb into the {Sentinel's Mark} applied by {Lunar Calling}, and throw {Moonlight Chakram} within 15 seconds
Time the {Don't Look Back} shield from consuming {Sentinel's Mark} right before big AoE damage

pack-leader.title: Pack Leader Key Points
items: {Takedown} summons a beast instantly via {Stampede!}, so line it up with big pulls and boss burst windows
{Kill Command} and {Raptor Strike} reduce the beast cooldown via {Dire Summons}, so keep consuming {Tip of the Spear}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] When the Ssscavenging shield goes up, dump Takedown and Boomstick into it
[회피] If Regurgitate hits you and cuts your movement speed by 50%, clear it with Disengage (Posthaste)
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Take a slot in the Toxic Atrophy 3-interrupt rotation with Muzzle (15s)
[위치] During Death Rattle, break the Vine Grip tether immediately with Disengage (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] When Uncoil spawns 5 Writhes, reduce Boomstick's cooldown with a Wildfire Bomb cone and fire Boomstick into the stacked Writhes
Zul'jan: [참고] Block a Ritual of the Fang beam for a few seconds, then Feign Death to stop one beam (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] If Ritual Venom stacks up during the Ritual of the Fang channel and your health is low, use Survival of the Fittest

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Take a slot in Kezkitt's Light Bolt rotation with Muzzle
[회피] If targeted by Thornblade, you can block the bleed with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] If rooted by Bloodthorn Roots, break free with Disengage (Posthaste); with a Cunning pet, free allies with Master's Call (Wowhead)
[회피] If targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, you can drop the chase with Feign Death. Don't use it if more roots still need breaking (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Save Survival of the Fittest for the Lightcrazed Frenzy phase after 50%
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Take a slot in Moonkin Form's Warden's Wrath rotation with Muzzle
[참고] If hit by Grievous Thrash, top up with Exhilaration to clear it fast, or block it entirely with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[회피] If targeted by Pulverizing Strikes, you can cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead)
Ziekket: [차단] Interrupt the Lashers' Lightspore Shot with Muzzle before they revive
[참고] Don't step on Lightbloom's Essence orbs while in Aspect of the Turtle. You won't get the Lightbloom's Might damage buff (Wowhead)

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Clear the Toxic Spores poison yourself with Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle (Emergency Salve). During Aspect of the Turtle you can run over several mushrooms (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for the Ravenous Bellow physical AoE
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Take a slot in the Winter's Shroud rotation of both Fractured Shivercores with Muzzle; if one is missed, stop it with Intimidation
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest during the Frozen Tempest raid-wide DoT
Nalorakk: [위치] During Fury of the War God, Aspect of the Turtle lets you block several Echoes of Nalorakk without Spectral Slash (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for the Overwhelming Onslaught 3-hit physical combo

Kystia Manaheart: [제어] Stop the Mirror Images clones with Intimidation and Freezing Trap, and interrupt Felstorm with Muzzle (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Hold Takedown for the Destabilized window, and move Hunter's Mark to the target you're hitting (Nibbles, Kystia) (Wowhead)
Zaen Bladesorrow: [회피] Murder in a Row can be blocked with Aspect of the Turtle even without a barrel (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for the armor-ignoring Killing Spree AoE
Xathuux the Annihilator: [회피] Block the Infernal Crush DoT with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Line up Takedown with Demonic Rage, when the boss takes 30% more damage
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Take a slot in the Chaos Bolt rotation with Muzzle
[위치] You can cross Malefic Wave safely with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[제어] Tether the Wild Imps gathered by Fingers of Gul'dan with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) and kill them with Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick

Taz'Rah: [회피] If you moved away to dodge Void Fissure orbs, Harpoon straight back to the boss to cut DPS downtime
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for the Dark Bloom shadow AoE
Atroxus: [해제] Clear the Poison Splash and Mind-Numbing Poison poisons yourself with Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle (Emergency Salve, Wowhead)
[우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper spawns, throw Wildfire Bomb with the Creeper as the primary target and catch it in the Boomstick cone along with the boss
Charonus: [회피] Block the 20s Cosmic Crash DoT with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[위치] If targeted by Gravitic Orbs, clear the Condensed Mass slow with Disengage (Posthaste) while dragging them to the Unstable Singularity (Wowhead)
[회피] If targeted by Void Cascade, you can cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Tether Animated Gold with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) to slow its approach to the boss (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Put Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick into stacked Animated Gold
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Interrupt the Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge with Muzzle
[해제] If an interrupt is missed and you get the Wretched Discharge disease, clear it yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve, Wowhead)
[회피] If targeted by Drain Fluids, you can cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead)
The Council of Tribes: [위치] Aka'ali's Barrel Through can be cancelled with Feign Death, or soaked alone with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[차단] Take a slot in Zanazal's Poison Nova rotation with Muzzle
[해제] If Poison Nova poisons you, clear it yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve)
Dazar, The First King: [차단] Take a slot in Reban's Deathly Roar rotation with Muzzle
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for the Gilded Destruction burst AoE, and hold on with Exhilaration through the 15s DoT

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Take a slot in the Frigid Shard rotation with Muzzle
[위치] If targeted by Chillstorm, drop the storm and get out fast with Disengage (Wowhead)
[제어] Tether intermission Infused Whelps with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) to cut down Cold Claws melee hits (Wowhead)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Take a slot in Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley rotation with Muzzle
[참고] Feign Death right before Blazebound Firestorm's Inferno cast finishes to avoid its damage (Wowhead)
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [우선 처치] When Kyrakka comes down, Harpoon in and use Takedown
[광역 피해] Save Takedown and Boomstick for the start of phase 2

Adderis & Aspix: [참고] When Storm Blessed moves, move Hunter's Mark to the boss that isn't immune (Wowhead)
[위치] Thunder and Lightning can be soaked alone with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
Merektha: [제어] Free allies bound by A Knot of Snakes with Intimidation or Freezing Trap. If you're bound, drop a Freezing Trap at your feet and stand still to break free (Wowhead)
[차단] Interrupt the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Muzzle; if hit, clear the poison yourself with Feign Death (Emergency Salve, Wowhead)
Galvazzt: [광역 피해] If Galvanized stacks up while blocking the Lightning Spire beam, use Survival of the Fittest
[위치] Move quickly with Aspect of the Cheetah during beam swaps
Avatar of Sethraliss: [위치] Corrupted Lifeforce can be soaked back-to-back with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[제어] Tether phase 2 Faithless Tormentors with Binding Shot (Sentinel build) to slow their chase on the healer (Wowhead)
[차단] Interrupt the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Muzzle

781.m: Unlimited range · Instant · 20 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
781.d: Leap backwards [Posthaste: clearing movement impairing effects, and increasing your movement speed by 0% for 4 sec] [Narrow Escape: and activating a web trap which encases all targets within 8 yards in sticky webs, preventing movement for 8 sec].

982.d: Revives your pet, returning it to life with 100% of its base health.

1543.d: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within the targeted area for 20 sec.

5384.d: Feign death, tricking enemies into ignoring you. Lasts up to 6 min.

19577.m: Talent · 100 yd range · Instant · 1 min cooldown
19577.d: Commands your pet to intimidate the target stunning your target for 5 sec.

19801.m: Talent · 40 yd range · Instant · 10 sec cooldown
19801.d: Removes 1 Enrage and 1 Magic effect from an enemy target.

34477.m: Talent · 100 yd range · Instant · 30 sec cooldown
34477.d: Misdirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next attack within 30 sec and lasting for 8 sec.

53480.m: Talent · 40 yd range · Instant · 2 min cooldown
53480.d:
Instructs your pet to protect a friendly target, reducing their damage taken by 15%, but 50% of all damage taken by that target is transferred to your pet.

Lasts 10 sec or until your pet's health drops below 25%.

109215.d: Disengage also frees you from all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

109248.m: Talent · 30 yd range · Instant · 45 sec cooldown
109248.d: Fires a magical projectile, tethering the enemy and any other enemies within 5 yds for 10 sec, stunning them for 3 sec if they move more than 5 yds from the arrow. [Binding Shackles: Targets stunned by Binding Shot deal 10% less damage to you for 8 sec after the effect ends]

109304.d: Heals you for 30% and your pet for 100% of maximum health. [Rejuvenating Wind: Exhilaration heals you for an additional 12.0% of your maximum health over 8 sec]

186257.d: Increases your movement speed by 90% for 3 sec. Upon expiring, increases your movement speed by 30% for another 9 sec.

186265.d: Causes all spells and attacks to miss and reduces all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec, but you cannot attack.

186270.d: A vicious slash dealing (393.25% of Attack Power) Physical damage.

187650.d: Hurls a frost trap to the target location that incapacitates the first enemy that approaches for 1 min. Damage may break the effect. Limit 1. Trap will exist for 1 min.

187707.m: Talent · Melee Range · Instant · 15 sec cooldown
187707.d: Interrupts spellcasting, preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

190925.m: 8 - 30 yd range · Instant · 20 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
190925.d: Hurls a harpoon at an enemy, rooting them in place for 3 sec and pulling you to them.

199921.d: Your movement speed is increased by 30% anytime you have not attacked for 3 sec.

257284.d:
Apply Hunter's Mark to the target, causing the target to always be seen and tracked by the Hunter.

Hunter's Mark increases the target's damage taken by 3%. Can only be applied to 1 target at a time.

259489.m: Talent · 50 yd range · Instant · 5 sec recharge · 2 Charges
259489.d:
Give the command to kill, causing your pet to savagely deal (300% of Attack Power) Physical damage to the enemy.

Generates 15 / Invigorating Pulse: 20 / Flanker's Advantage: 20 Focus.

Increases the damage of your next non-Kill Command ability by 0%.

259495.m: Talent · 10 Focus · 40 yd range · Instant · 18 sec cooldown · 1 Charge
259495.d:
Hurl a bomb at the target, exploding for (190% of Attack Power) Fire damage in a cone and coating enemies in wildfire, scorching them for (125.928% of Attack Power) Fire damage over 6 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Deals 50% increased damage to your primary target.

260248.d: You and your pet gain 10% attack speed for every bleeding enemy within 12 yds.

260285.d: Kill Command increases the direct damage of your other abilities by 15%, stacking up to 3 times.

264332.d: Wildfire Bomb now has 2 charges, and the initial explosion deals 15% increased damage.

264667.d:
Increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.

Allies receiving this effect will become Sated and unable to benefit from Primal Rage or similar effects again for 10 min.

264735.m: Talent · Unlimited range · Instant · 1.5 min cooldown · 1 Charge
264735.d: Reduces all damage you and your pet take by 30% for 6 sec.

266921.d: The cooldown of Aspect of the Eagle, Aspect of the Cheetah, and Aspect of the Turtle are reduced by 15 sec.

270581.d: Exhilaration's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

272682.d: Your pet removes all root and movement impairing effects from itself and a friendly target, and grants immunity to all such effects for 4 sec.

The damage of your auto-attacks is increased by 25%.

Your Agility is increased by 3%, increased by an additional 1% while dual-wielding.

378937.d: Wildfire Bomb and Boomstick damage increased by 5%.

384799.d: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 5%.

385539.d: Exhilaration now also heals you for an additional 12.0% of your maximum health over 8 sec.

450373.d: Consuming Sentinel's Mark grants you an absorb shield equal to 10.0% of your maximum health.

459517.d: Feign Death and Aspect of the Turtle removes poison and disease effects from you.

459843.d: Boomstick increases the cooldown recovery rate of Wildfire Bomb by 60% for 8 sec.

459964.d: Kill Command grants an additional 5 Focus and its critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

460198.d:
Kill Command damage increased by 15%.

Kill Command reduces the cooldown of Wildfire Bomb by 1.0 sec.

462036.d: Wildfire Bomb deals 20% increased critical strike damage.

471876.d:
While in combat, every 30 sec your next Kill Command summons the aid of a Beast.

Wyvern
A Wyvern descends from the skies, letting out a battle cry that increases the damage of you and your pets by 10% for 12 sec.

Boar
A Boar charges through your target 1 time, dealing (1440% of Attack Power) damage to nearby enemies and an additional (1200% of Attack Power) physical damage to its primary target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Bear
A Bear leaps into the fray, rending the flesh of your enemies, dealing (400% of Attack Power) damage over 10 sec to up to 8 nearby enemies.

472352.d:
Kill Command reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.5 sec.

Raptor Strike reduces the cooldown of Howl of the Pack Leader by 1.0 sec.

(700ms cooldown)

472550.d:
Your pet's attacks increase your Wyvern's damage bonus by 1%, up to 10%.

Casting Wildfire Bomb extends the duration of your Wyvern by 5.0 sec, up to 10 additional sec.

472639.d: Each time your Boar deals damage, the damage of your next Boomstick is increased by 5%, up to 20%.

472741.d:
Casting Takedown grants Howl of the Pack Leader and causes your next Kill Command to rouse the nearby wildlife into a Stampede, charging your target and dealing [(150% of Attack Power) * 9] Physical damage over 7 sec.

(5s cooldown)

1250646.d:
You and your pet leap to your target and strike as one, dealing [(600% of Attack Power) + (1200% of Attack Power)] Physical damage. Your pet frees itself from roots when it leaps.

For the next 8 sec, the damage dealt by you and your pet is increased by 20%.

Generates 50 Focus.

1251717.d:
Consuming Tip of the Spear provokes your pet to attack your target, dealing (180% of Attack Power) Physical damage.

All damage dealt by your pet is increased by 30%. (700ms cooldown)

1252708.d: Raptor Strike increases the damage of Raptor Strike by 10% for 8 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

1252931.d:
Your Boomstick's damage is increased by 40% when striking a single target.

Each additional target reduces this bonus by 5%.

1253053.d: Raptor Strike and Kill Command gain 10% increased critical strike chance and 10% increased critical damage dealt.

1253137.d: When Strike as One critically strikes, it bleeds its target for an additional (40% of Attack Power) damage over 5 sec.

1253172.d: Wildfire Bomb's periodic effect is now a Bleed and grants you and your pet 15 Focus over 3 sec.

1253176.d: All Fire damage dealt is increased by 8%.

1253599.d:
Consuming Tip of the Spear has a 10% chance to summon the aid of a Sentinel Owl that descends from the skies and applies Sentinel's Mark to your target.

Sentinel's Mark

1253852.d: Takedown summons your Sentinel Owl and your chance to summon your Sentinel Owl is increased by an additional 10% during Takedown.

1257011.d: Raptor Strike and Boomstick deal 20% increased critical strike damage.

1258485.d: The cooldown of Aspect of the Turtle is reduced by 30 sec.

1259019.d:

For 15 sec after casting Takedown, Takedown is replaced with Moonlight Chakram.

Moonlight Chakram
Throw a chakram blessed with moonlight at your current target that will rapidly deal (284.4% of Attack Power) Physical damage 7 times, bouncing to other targets if they are nearby.

1272139.d: Takedown grants 3 stacks of Tip of the Spear.

1272154.d:
Kill Command grants 1 additional stack of Tip of the Spear.

Tip of the Spear's damage bonus is increased by 5%.

1311963.d: Wildfire Bomb damage increased by 15%, critical strike chance increased by 15%, and critical damage dealt increased by 15%.

53480.d:
야수가 아군 대상을 보호하여 받는 피해를 15%만큼 감소시키지만, 대상이 받는 모든 피해의 50%가 야수에게 이전됩니다.

10초 동안 혹은 야수의 생명력이 25% 미만으로 떨어질 때까지 지속됩니다.

109215.d: 철수 사용 시 모든 이동 방해 효과가 제거되고, 이동 속도가 4초 동안 50%만큼 증가합니다.

109248.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
109248.d: 마력이 담긴 투사체를 발사하여 투사체로부터 5미터 반경 내의 적들을 10초 동안 구속합니다. 적이 화살에서 5미터 이상 떨어질 경우 3초 동안 기절시킵니다. [억제의 족쇄: 구속의 사격으로 기절 상태가 된 대상의 효과가 사라지면 8초 동안 대상에게 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다]

109304.m: 45 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
109304.d: 자신의 생명력이 30%만큼, 야수의 생명력이 최대 생명력의 100%만큼 회복됩니다. [원기 회복의 바람: 활기 시전 시 8초에 걸쳐 최대 생명력의 12.0%만큼 추가로 생명력을 회복합니다]

186257.d: 3초 동안 이동 속도가 90%만큼 증가합니다. 효과가 만료되면 추가로 9초 동안 이동 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

186265.d: 8초 동안 모든 주문과 공격이 빗나가고, 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다. 단, 공격할 수 없게 됩니다.

186270.d: 잔인하게 적을 공격하여 (전투력의 393.25%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

187650.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
187650.d: 목표 위치로 냉기 덫을 발사합니다. 적이 다가오면 1분 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 받으면 효과가 사라집니다. 한 번에 하나만 사용할 수 있으며, 덫은 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

187707.m: 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
187707.d: 주문 시전을 차단하고 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하는 것을 방해합니다.

190925.m: 8 - 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
190925.d: 적에게 작살을 던져, 3초 동안 이동 불가 상태로 만들고 그쪽으로 이동합니다.

199921.d: 3초 동안 공격을 하지 않으면 이동 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

257284.d:
대상에게 사냥꾼의 징표를 겁니다. 사냥꾼은 징표에 걸린 대상을 항상 볼 수 있고, 추적할 수 있습니다.

사냥꾼의 징표는 대상이 받는 피해를 3%만큼 증가시킵니다. 한 번에 한 대상에게만 부여할 수 있습니다.

259489.m: 특성 · 50 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 5 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
259489.d:
야수에게 살상 명령을 내려 적에게 흉포하게 (전투력의 300%)의 물리 피해를 입히게 합니다.

15 / 활기의 파동: 20 / 기습의 이점: 20의 집중을 생성합니다.

Increases the damage of your next non-Kill Command ability by 0%.

259495.m: 특성 · 집중 10 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 18 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
259495.d:
대상에게 폭탄을 던집니다. 폭탄은 폭발하며 부채꼴 범위 내 적들에게 (전투력의 190%)의 화염 피해를 입히고, 야생불로 뒤덮어 6초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 125.928%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

주 대상에게는 50%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

260248.d: 12미터 내에 있는 출혈 상태의 적 하나당 자신과 야수의 공격 속도가 10%만큼 증가합니다.

260285.d: 살상 명령 사용 시 다른 능력의 직접 피해를 15%만큼 증가시킵니다. 최대 3번까지 중첩됩니다.

264332.d: 야생불 폭탄이 2번 충전되며, 최초 폭발 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

264667.d:
40초 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

효과를 받은 아군은 만족함 상태가 되어 10분 동안 원초적 분노 또는 유사 효과를 받지 못합니다.

264735.m: 특성 · 사정거리 없음 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
264735.d: 6초 동안 자신과 야수가 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다.

266921.d: 독수리의 상, 치타의 상, 거북의 상의 재사용 대기시간이 15초만큼 감소합니다.

272682.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
272682.d: 야수가 자신 및 아군 대상 1명에게 걸린 모든 이동 불가 및 이동 방해 효과를 제거하고, 4초 동안 야수와 대상이 유사한 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

378934.d:
자동 공격의 공격력이 25%만큼 증가합니다.

민첩성이 3%만큼 증가하며, 쌍수 무기를 사용하는 동안에는 추가로 1%만큼 증가합니다.

385539.d: 활기 시전 시 8초에 걸쳐 최대 생명력의 12.0%만큼 추가로 회복합니다.

450373.d: 파수꾼의 표식을 소모하면 최대 생명력의 10.0%에 해당하는 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 얻습니다.

459517.d: 죽은 척하기 및 거북의 상 사용 시 독과 질병 효과를 제거합니다.

459843.d: 붐스틱 사용 시 8초 동안 야생불 폭탄의 재사용 대기시간 회복 속도가 60%만큼 증가합니다.

459964.d: 살상 명령 사용 시 5의 집중을 추가로 생성하고 치명타 및 극대화율이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

460198.d:
살상 명령의 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

살상 명령이 야생불 폭탄의 재사용 대기시간을 1.0초만큼 감소시킵니다.

462036.d: 야생불 폭탄의 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

471876.d:
전투 중 30초마다 다음 살상 명령 사용 시 맹수를 소환하여 지원을 받습니다.

와이번
와이번이 하늘에서 내려와 전투의 함성을 내질러 12초 동안 사냥꾼과 야수의 공격력을 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.

멧돼지
멧돼지가 시전자의 대상에게 1회 돌진하여 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 1440%)의 피해를 입히고, 주 대상에게는 (전투력의 1200%)의 추가 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

곰
곰이 전투에 난입해 적을 찢어발깁니다. 주위에 있는 최대 8명의 적에게 10초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 400%)의 피해를 입힙니다.

472352.d:
살상 명령 사용 시 무리의 지도자의 포효의 재사용 대기시간이 1.5초만큼 감소합니다.

랩터의 일격 사용 시 무리의 지도자의 포효의 재사용 대기시간이 1.0초만큼 감소합니다.

(700밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

472550.d:
야수의 공격이 와이번의 공격력 증가량을 1%만큼, 최대 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.

야생불 폭탄 시전 시 와이번의 지속시간이 5.0초만큼, 최대 10초만큼 연장됩니다.

472639.d: 멧돼지가 피해를 입힐 때마다 다음 붐스틱의 공격력이 5%만큼, 최대 20%만큼 증가합니다.

472741.d:
제압 시전 시 무리의 지도자의 포효가 부여되고 다음 살상 명령이 주위의 야생동물을 자극해 쇄도를 일으켜, 대상에게 돌진해 7초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 150%) * 9]의 물리 피해를 입히게 합니다.

(5초 재사용 대기시간)

1250646.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
1250646.d:
시전자와 야수가 대상에게 도약해 동시에 공격을 날려 [(전투력의 600%) + (전투력의 1200%)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 야수는 도약할 때 이동 불가 상태를 해제합니다.

다음 8초 동안 시전자와 야수가 입히는 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

50의 집중을 생성합니다.

1251717.d:
창끝을 소모하면 야수가 자극을 받아 대상을 공격해 (전투력의 180%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

야수가 입히는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 증가합니다. (700밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1252708.d: 랩터의 일격 시전 시 8초 동안 랩터의 일격의 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다. 여러 번 사용 시 효과가 중첩됩니다.

1252931.d:
단일 대상 공격 시 붐스틱의 공격력이 40%만큼 증가합니다.

추가 대상 하나당 이 추가 효과가 5%만큼 감소합니다.

1253053.d: 랩터의 일격 및 살상 명령 사용 시 치명타 및 극대화율이 10%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 10%만큼 증가합니다.

1253137.d: 한마음 한뜻으로가 치명타 및 극대화로 적중하면 대상에게 출혈을 일으켜 5초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 40%)의 피해를 입힙니다.

1253172.d: 야생불 폭탄의 주기적인 효과가 출혈 효과가 되며, 3초에 걸쳐 사냥꾼과 야수에게 15의 집중을 부여합니다.

1253599.d:
창끝을 소모하면 10%의 확률로 파수꾼 올빼미를 소환합니다. 올빼미는 하늘에서 강하하여 대상에게 파수꾼의 표식을 부여합니다.

파수꾼의 표식
다음 야생불 폭탄 사용 시 징표가 남겨진 대상에게 40%의 추가 직접 피해

1253601.d: 다음 야생불 폭탄이 징표가 남겨진 대상에게 40%의 추가 직접 피해를 입힙니다.

1253732.d: 파수꾼의 표식을 소모할 때 달의 투사체 4개를 퍼부어 10미터 내의 적에게 (전투력의 200%)의 비전 피해를 입힙니다.

1253852.d: 제압이 파수꾼 올빼미를 소환하며, 제압의 지속시간 동안 파수꾼 올빼미를 소환할 확률이 10%만큼 추가로 증가합니다.

1257011.d: 랩터의 일격과 붐스틱의 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

1259019.d:
랩터의 일격 사용 시 랩터의 휩쓸기로 강화되어 전방 15미터 내의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 280%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

창끝의 효과를 받는 랩터의 휩쓸기는 300%의 효율로 한마음 한뜻으로를 발동시킵니다.

1261193.m: 특성 · 집중 50 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (3 초 주문 시전 시간) · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
1261193.d: 전방 20미터에 산탄총을 4회 연이어 발사해 3초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 607.5%) * 4]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1261229.d: 붐스틱으로 한 명 이상의 적에게 피해를 입히면 야생불 폭탄의 재사용 대기시간이 3.0초만큼 감소합니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1262409.d: 야생불 폭탄이 적중당한 대상 하나당 붐스틱의 재사용 대기시간을 2.0초만큼, 최대 10초만큼 감소시킵니다.

1264902.d:
제압 시전 후 15초 동안 제압이 달빛 회전 표창으로 대체됩니다.

달빛 회전 표창
현재 대상에게 달빛의 축복을 받은 회전 표창을 날려 빠르게 (전투력의 284.4%)의 물리 피해를 7번 입히고 주위에 다른 대상이 있으면 튕기게 합니다.

(1초 재사용 대기시간)

1272154.d:
살상 명령이 창끝 1중첩을 추가로 부여합니다.

창끝의 공격력 증가 효과가 5%만큼 증가합니다.

1311963.d: 야생불 폭탄의 공격력이 15%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화율이 15%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 15%만큼 증가합니다.
